in_text_mentions: A 36-year-old male presented to our burn center after sustaining a 3% indeterminate partial-thickness burn (2nd degree) to his left hand and anterolateral aspect of his left thigh and knee (Figure 3). He sustained superficial partial-thickness burns to his left palm while trying to put out the fire.
